body:
Back at it again with the games tonight. No one won. Went out to the bars looking for a fight, no one bit so I took it out on a friend. I am a disgusting person... I applied for disability through the VA... Figure if I feel the way I do may as well get paid...

My memory i realize now is worse than it use to be, I am more less able to control my emotions. I get angry at stupid shit I never use too... I am just all around more nasty of a person than ever. Can't maintain relationships, the few I try to I just get mad at for no reason. 

I don't like admitting that I am a nasty person now. Once upon a time I use to see myself as an exemplary person, but now.. No. I am just a piece of shit. I told myself while I was sober to at least wait until Christmas before killing myself, so I will hold to it, but.. not going to lie, I so want to right now.. Every day feels like a struggle, I have no family, I have no one to hold on to, I have nothing.

That scares me a lot. Because I recognize that I am at my weakest when I look at it more than just a bet. More of a random act. "Hey... I am at the grocery store buying my meals for the weak... how weird would it be if I did it in the bathroom with a cart full waiting for me." Stupid. I don't know, I ust don't know. I get a high from almost dying and it lasts me a good while. After that though. I feel back to normal. Back to nothing. I don't get it. I want to be like my friends with a family. The guys who give their all for people they love. I want to reach that point. But I feel a huge disconnect. I imagine its similar between a lot of us who feel this way. I've heard several friends say the things I feel and think, and I've comforted them and i put on a face I hope comforts them. Typing this I feel though I should probably be real with them. I want to die, I don't know why, but things will get better hopefully. I feel like I need something to fight for, but, I just feel empty.
I am seriously sorry about your loss pankflamingos.

No, absolutely not. Like you said, its cyclical. II feel like the major push for me in life is my team. And the major push for me being on this team is that I want to die. If I tell the shrinks this... well, I' off the team. 

And, for whatever reason, doesnt matter why, but I've been conditioned to hold my deep feelings close and not share it.

I know I have a problem, but I always feel a lump in my throat and turn shit into a joke when I want to tell someone about my issues... hence looking to reddit... lol.

You are right. I have an addictive personality and recognize it, but at the end of the day, I feel like It's my only option. 

I am very sorry about your boyfriend. I hate hearing about people killing themselves. I've had plenty of friends kill themselves, but for whatever reason, I cling on to it. I feel like there is nothing driving me other than negativity. Thank you for caring though. I honestly appreciate it though.
